part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts:65 — when the input source map lacks a `sourcesContent` array, `this._inputMap.sourcesContent[i]` threw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')`. Changed it to `this._inputMap.sourcesContent?.[i]`, which safely passes `undefined` to `setSourceContent`.

Verification:
- Rebuilt packages (`yarn gulp build`) since tests run against `lib/` output
- `packages/babel-generator`: 591 passed, including the previously failing `generation > inputSourceMap without sourcesContent`
- `packages/babel-core`, `babel-traverse`, `babel-template`: 979 passed, no regressions
